title: Grateful Dead Live at Shrine Auditorium on 1967-11-10
lineage: SBD Reel from WB Vault to reel @ 7.5 IPS to reel@ 7.5 IPS to digital domain. Korg MR 1000 at 1 bit 5.6 mhz to 24-96 via Korg software. Taped by: Dan Healy; Transfer By: Matt Smith & Bob Menke; Mastering By: Derek McCabe

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard recording of a classic ’67 set with solid song choices and good overall audio quality.
ai_review.review: The fan notes that the SBD source delivers a nicely balanced, clear sound for this era, despite some mis‑labeling of tracks. The show features a pleasant selection of 1967 material – highlighted by “Viola Lee” and “Hurts Me Too” – and is regarded as a classic, well‑chosen set.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review (4‑star) praising both the performance and sound quality; limited detail keeps confidence low but rating reflects the positive assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced audio typical of the era; track listing is inaccurate but no major sonic issues reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Straightforward presentation of classic ’67 material with solid pacing and enjoyable song choices.
